title: Queue routing mismatch guard in alert evaluation activity
answers: Why did alert evaluation skip without recording an errored check when detector config changed?
How does evaluate_alert prevent AI detector checks from running on standard workers without credentials?
What happens if an alert detector type is modified between workflow prepare and evaluate activities?
body:
Symptom: Alert check evaluation fails with worker credential errors or crashes if an alert's detector configuration is changed right before evaluation.
Root cause: posthog/temporal/alerts/activities.py:evaluate_alert reloaded the alert configuration from the database without confirming it matched inputs.uses_llm_detector chosen during workflow prepare.
Fix pattern: Compare the reloaded detector type against the routed input type; if mismatched, return early with alert_check_id=None and preserve next_check_at so the next scheduler tick can re-route.
Constraints: Applies to Temporal workflow activities where queue routing is decided in an earlier step based on mutable database state.
applies: Temporal alert workflow activities routing between AI and standard worker queues
